structural_change: s81sl_xrt3t (STW-S81c-COLLA3 10-22, MAIN; from s81sl_xrt3r, same RTL @7cc24af0a+, outline 570.24 x 395.28, pins, PDN, layers, cycles): k-means regional CTS K=16 -> K=24. Why: the xrt3r --cts gate (pve1 20261022-155324) FAILED only clock_rule: 23,729 sinks, 9,302 boundary pin flops on a four-face perimeter ring (1,931 um), K=16 clusters uneven 636..2,842 sinks (largest CTS sub-trees deeper) -> TT pin-flop spread 573.8..662.4 = 88.6 ps, FF 79.1; xrt3r_b (596 x 432) 105.9 / 88.7. Same failure class and fix as dscoll_lane s8nk K=16 (TT 83-88) -> s8nq K=24 / s8nr K=32 (55.5 / 51.7): shorter ring arcs (~80 um each), one local root per arc, equal-load roots under the balanced top tree. No timing constraint relaxed. | s81sl_xrt3r (STW-S81c-COLLA3 10-22, from s81sl_xrt3p; xrt3p NEEDS_RTL TT -40.12 / FF -18.04, xrt3q TT -32.27 / FF -20.41, hold ECO least-bad TT -3.12 / FF +15.37 = hold repairable once TT has room): XRT3R RTL (1) the S-face x_eps / x_scale / x_mode consumers get their own KEPT stage-1 raw-word copies ebx/wbx/vbx (= eb2/wb2/vb2 bits 46+{0..32,64..95}) and one-hot select copies bsex_c/bswx_c (= bse_c/bsw_c), so the 3:1 body select sits beside the x flops (was bsw_c -> body -> 4 repeaters -> x_eps, 1 body bit feeding W/N/S faces); (2) owner-match predecode pq_m{e,w,v} captured as two byte halves (8-bit AND-OR at the pin, OR2 after the flops; was dl_e -> pq_me I2R -12.6). Same values on the same edges: ports, cycles, latency unchanged (bench exact PASS FOREG 0, hops/bwide/xhold mutants caught). FF I2R pin-flop hold class (p_d->pd, lo_d->lod, dl_w->wb) is left to the standard hold repair that the TT room now allows.
